name: The Crash Test Dummies
caption: Won the N.E.W. Tag Team Championship as newcomers, upsetting a team built from two members of a top singles stable.

tenures.note: Won the N.E.W. Tag Team Championship Tournament final over Vinny Vitrone and Apocalypse at King of the Mat 2 (6 April 1998); still champions as of Friday Night Slam Dance (24 April 1998).
